title: BCECE-LE Counselling/ Choice Filling 2026
organization: Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board
vacancyDetails: Online choice filling and seat allotment for Diploma holders seeking 2nd year Engineering admission
qualification: Diploma in Engineering / eligible LE qualification + BCECE-LE rank
applicationFee: Counselling fee as per BCECEB notice
selectionProcess: BCECE-LE Exam → Rank → Online Choice Filling → Seat Allotment → Document Verification
documentsRequired: Photo, signature, educational certificates, photo ID, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit https://bceceboard.bihar.gov.in or bcece.admissions.nic.in
2. Open BCECE[LE] Engineering counselling portal
3. Login and complete choice filling
4. Lock choices before deadline (extended as per board notices)
5. Check allotment and report for DV
shortDescription: BCECE-LE Counselling / Choice Filling 2026 for Engineering lateral entry – register and fill choices on bceceboard.bihar.gov.in.
content:
BCECEB has started BCECE [LE] Engineering 2026 online counselling and choice filling for lateral entry admissions.

Choice filling window was open around mid-July 2026 (with extension notices). Candidates must lock preferences and complete document verification after allotment.

Official: bceceboard.bihar.gov.in.
